reading_note: The two action types and their one target are the whole grant. An action type absent here is not permitted by this envelope; a target outside the list is refused by the P13 AuthorityGate. This envelope grants no cycle basis: observing and recording stand on P13-ENV-01. It states no expiry because FDR-3 states none; it exhausts itself once S-OPS-01's window has ended and the object is CLOSED (definition §11).
